title: random cat
description: this adds a cat in your inventory, thats it
body:
# hello
this mod adds a cat in the inventory

im planning to add more cats in the future so check sometimes for new versions.
i draw all of the cats added in so if they look dumb thats my fault.

![poorly drawn white and black cat in the minecraft inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e05a50df96da8f819bdeaeaf56394f7e5b1e706.png)

**faq**

Q: is it a dog

A: no it is a cat

very cool.
